fields.evidence: Series resistances 1/(h pi D) + ln(Do/Di)/(2 pi k), U = 1/(Rtot pi Dbore). The ThermalExplorer panel shows only fixed teaching builds (no numeric inputs), so the learner computes by hand. Closed form reproduced exactly (difference 0) by the vendored engine functions on the prompt inputs; tol is 5e-7 of the value, fine at full precision.
fields.notes: No entry precision is stated in the prompt or the working-the-capstone lesson; tol is 5e-7 relative (pd6_fields.mjs:650 'seven-significant-figure rounding'), so a learner who types four or five significant figures fails. Suggest the prompt say 'to at least seven significant figures'.
